title: Homebase Review (2026)
intro: Homebase is evaluated here as a frontline workforce management and scheduling platform — Homebase is an SMB frontline app for hourly scheduling, time clocks, team comms, and light hiring. Published per-location plans: Basic free (1 location, ≤10 employees); Essentials $30/$24 monthly vs annual; Plus $70/$56; All-in-One $120/$96 with unlimited employees on paid tiers. 14-day All-in-One trial. Payroll, tip manager, and hiring boosts are add-ons. Multi-site TCO is location-count, not headcount. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Homebase when SMB hourly scheduling and time clocks priced per location is the job — not when you need restaurant-only WFM, multi-entity Deputy, or a core HRIS.
verdict: Choose Homebase when SMB hourly scheduling and time clocks priced per location is the job — not when you need restaurant-only WFM, multi-entity Deputy, or a core HRIS. Compare Connecteam for deskless hubs, When I Work for cheap per-user scheduling, Deputy for mid-market compliance, and 7shifts for restaurants. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Homebase is the SMB hourly default for replacing paper schedules. Score reflects first-party packaging, not hands-on lab testing.
Primary job is frontline WFM (scheduling + time + light hiring). Scored inside WFM, not against ATS or core HRIS.
Scheduling, clocks, comms, and optional payroll/hiring are solid for SMB. Held at 8 vs Deputy’s deeper multi-location compliance.
POS/payroll connectors are marketed for hourly ops; adequate SMB depth, not an enterprise HCM graph.
Hourly mobile scheduling and clock-in are the product thesis — scored as WFM mobility.
Labor reporting on paid tiers is adequate for SMB; not enterprise WFM BI.
Per-location paid unlimited employees helps a growing shop; multi-brand/mid-market is a different shortlist.
Meaningful free Basic plus $24 annual location floor is strong; add-ons and extra locations raise TCO. Affiliate economics excluded.
Scheduling Assistant (Plus+) and Hiring/Payroll assistants are published — useful, plan-gated AI.

faq.question: Is Homebase HR / workforce software?
faq.answer: Yes. Homebase is evaluated as a frontline workforce management and scheduling platform.

faq.question: How is Homebase priced?
faq.answer: Free Basic (1 location, ≤10 employees). Paid per location annual: Essentials $24 / Plus $56 / All-in-One $96/mo (monthly higher). Payroll add-on. 14-day trial. Confirm on joinhomebase.com/pricing.

faq.question: Does Homebase have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: Yes — a free plan is published. A free trial is documented (about 14 days). Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Homebase?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
